summary:
Independent DESIGN Review of the complete frozen Task56 specification b589852985fea26583efe09009aefe710465625ffac14609213c5d1caf3c1d70, native context 56d71328dcf0e153c00dbc70b6128b893ad52806ba58484917850e1abf715458, classification input a4c4da234481675e43defb342480d5010c15d897a65c7aec2cff0d2d7013b33b, DU-001 and all 24 scoped paths, amendment006, diagnostics008, preserved prior specification/failures, the external endpoint design, exact fixture delta and acceptance plan. Subject remains 87f4c0495e4e1d3697dcadc8437b5abaf42886d6; current observed HEAD ddf861b522d23b34f68a8285fbd5e4dee4f53f1a includes root-reported own-ledger preparation. No blocking design finding. This actual worker has not authored Task56 production, tests or fixtures; the same real worker reviews and verifies without claiming two distinct reviewers or an external product identity.

Permit only the exact existing fixture utility functions _template_for, _git_fact and _qualify to recognize the already provisioned complete Windows cmd/git.exe and same-prefix mingw64/bin/git.exe. Both ordinary safe counterpart files must exist; derive the same complete template and bind current bytes and modes of both executables. Unknown ucrt64, generic bin, missing or unsafe counterparts remain ineligible. Standard attributes paths derive only from this qualified prefix. The first real successful original-target builder must prove zero effective attributes for all initial working-tree relative paths with the real bounded query. Preserve live standard-file bytes, source/config/template/environment/locator and owner guards, ordinary parent containment, modes, snapshot identity and all before/after input checks. Unknown or changed applicability remains cold; configuration names, origins and values stay in memory. Preserve original mkdir ordering, partial errors, successful pristine task-free publication, independent copied .git/index/objects/refs/worktree, no hardlinks/alternates/shared mutable state, and warm-copy failure propagation without rebuild or retry.

The actual computed PATH changes from cmd to mingw64/bin; native _environment implementation and its whitelist do not change. Record the new actual environment honestly, inherit the normal real profile and temporary settings, and use only the scoped outer PATH prefix. No fake HOME/USERPROFILE/TMP/TEMP/GIT_*, global environment change, tool installation, executable copy or shim is admitted. Direct startup/helper/config/template/attributes behavior must be checked under the actual new environment. Production Git context, transport, Schema, validation, freshness and metadata/YAML-cache safety remain unchanged; no production registry cache is allowed. Under Rule8, fixture/test/documentation changes remain a distinct task-free safe unit, with governed specification and approvals in Task56. Scope stays at 24 paths.

Only the three explicitly named utility functions may change; new cases append to existing test paths. Every original consumer test-function/assertion AST, all original 53 fixture cases, original ten-second Git deadline and owned-tree bounded cleanup remain. Synthetic layout tests must avoid global os.name or Path-semantic changes and cannot authenticate the real runtime. The recognized complete Windows positive must call the original builder directly, prove task-free initial state and actual qualification/cold count, then prove a real warm hit; it must not use seed unsupported skip. The supported package must execute every old supported case and new real positive with zero additional qualification skip. Genuine unsupported/platform-inapplicable cold branches remain explicit; QUALIFICATION_FAILED, PUBLICATION_FAILED and INPUT_CHANGED never permit skipping.

The fixed candidate under the actual direct runtime requires narrow guard cases, the complete fixture and original external-review modules, followed by the complete unchanged integration selector within its original 600-second deadline. Existing completed metadata matrices may remain support only while the relevant production/test/runtime bytes are unchanged. Only actual prerequisite PASS permits exact locked 3.13.15 selection for fresh native V2 with current source/runtime/import/spec/Policy bindings and a fresh approved single-use action; consumed actions and prior failed receipts/logs remain preserved. All fourteen default checks, five fixed mutations, original selectors/deadlines, 85 percent total and 90 percent diff coverage, whitespace/Ruff/format/mypy, independent implementation Review, native finalization, current code approval and Gate remain mandatory. CI retains Python3.11, cmd discovery, required checks and branch protection. Task55 still requires its own admission and a truly gated dependency.

The forty paired identity-query observations support considering this endpoint only, not full command equivalence, end-to-end speed or 600-second PASS. The 194-case profiler observation preserves code identities and counts, but nine entry and forty-nine child-edge inline/total anomalies make all function-cost attribution unknown; no inclusive/exclusive/disjoint sums support optimization. Prior diagnostic exits do not replace the original 600-second or native gates. This APPROVE is solely the current frozen design judgment and asserts no implementation, runtime comparison, full V2, finalization, publication, provider or later-phase success or authorization.
